result.scope: Production Session, Codec and Client with injected transport; private files; production Worker/Runner POSIX pipe with a synthetic Client

tests.name: Schema 1 credentials load and upgrade without inventing renewal capability
Schema 2 private persistence retains renewal state and mode 0600
Uncertain confirmation survives restart and independently disables renewal capability
Browser exports retain actual expiry while raw Cookie imports remain metadata-free
Invalid refresh metadata is discarded without changing valid session identity
Repeated Set-Cookie headers merge without splitting an Expires date comma
LuaSocket comma-joined cookies honor later values and Max-Age precedence
Cookie response origins and domain scopes cannot cross unrelated hosts
Deletion cookies remove credentials and stale expiry metadata
Invalid cookie batches reject atomically without partial rotation
Unsupported cookie names and nonroot paths do not poison account cookies
Renewal secrets never enter account summaries or ordinary Codec records
Credential comparison ignores auxiliary cookie rotation but detects authentication changes
Malformed optional Set-Cookie cannot erase successful purchase or favorite receipts
Business and authentication errors retain precedence over malformed response cookies
Production Worker and real POSIX Runner carry updated cookies only in the private third result
Only a boolean changed marker permits a private worker update
A retryable failure with a private cookie update is returned before any raw retry

result.scope: Real Controller, Session, SessionStorage, SQLite and PageStore with controlled QR worker results

tests.name: Anonymous and invalidated accounts can begin an isolated QR sign-in
Waiting and scanned statuses preserve the account until verified confirmation
Confirmed QR replacement clears a previous invalid-session marker
Wrong keys and duplicate polls cannot create overlapping QR requests
Expired QR codes retire their key without replacing the current account
Canceled and superseded generation callbacks cannot resurrect stale QR state
Cancel suspend and close reject late confirmed credentials
Connectivity failures stop new and queued QR generation
Poll failures allow an explicit retry without altering the existing account
A private save failure preserves the previous selected account and saved file
Explicit import cancels QR polling and late QR success cannot replace the imported account
Starting QR sign-in retires an older pending import without canceling the new QR
Synchronous authentication workers do not leave phantom in-flight QR requests
